detail.title: Synthesis: Duality of Information Persistence
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes research on information persistence, bridging formal quantum error-correction mechanisms with macro-level economic technology diffusion. We model persistence as a two-tier requirement: structural integrity against entropy and adaptive relevance within an environmental selection pressure. The synthesis project 'proj-info-survival-002' has crossed the provisional notebook threshold.
